The audit is clean (score 100, no findings). I can't run the app to verify visually, so I'm stopping here.

**What was built** — `src/screens/Screen.tsx` renders a security settings screen with a "Two-factor authentication" card:
- A `Switch` turns 2FA on/off; a `Badge` shows the current On/Off status in words, not colour alone.
- Turning it **off** doesn't flip the switch immediately — it opens a controlled `AlertDialog` (`tone="danger"`) asking for confirmation, since it lowers account security. Confirming actually disables it; cancelling leaves it on.
- When on, a `RadioGroup` (card variant) lets the person choose **Authenticator app** or **Text message**, each with a description.
- Backup codes are shown in a monospaced grid inside an inset `CardContent`, with remaining-code count in the description.

All mock data lives in the file (`mockTwoFactor`), only `@syntara/react` components and `--syntara-*` tokens are used, logical CSS properties throughout, and every control has an accessible name via labels/descriptions.
